column1: # Functions that meet the "documented" stage (docs/PROGRESS.md): prototype, purpose, side effects and
# callers recorded here, applied to Ghidra by tools/ghidra/ApplySignatures.java, and described in the doc.
# Columns are tab-separated: address, C prototype, summary (purpose and side effects), document.

column3: summary
Builds the sorted disc file index from umd1: (PVD, path table, recursive directory walk). Side effects: allocates the pool, sets 0x089218c8/cc/d0/d4/d8, sorts, sets ready flag 0x089218dc.

column2: void container_index_directory(int fd, char *prefix, uint lba, int size)
column3: Appends one 16-byte index entry per file in an ISO 9660 directory and recurses into subdirectories. Side effects: advances 0x089218cc (entries) and 0x089218d0 (name pool).
Binary-searches the file index for path (without the disc0: prefix); returns the extent LBA or -1 and stores the size. No side effects.
Size of root-relative path: file index for disc paths, otherwise sceIoGetstat; -1 if missing. No side effects.

column2: int container_resolve_path(char *buf, int root, char *path, int no_lbn)
column3: Writes roots[root] + path into buf and, for indexed disc paths when no_lbn is 0, rewrites it as disc0:/sce_lbn0x%04x_size0x%04x. Returns 1. Side effects: buf only.
Non-zero when the path starts with the word "disc". No side effects.
Non-zero when the first three bytes are "EHP". No side effects.
Case-insensitive binary search of the EHP entry table; returns the (name offset, data offset) entry or 0. No side effects.
Member size: the unaligned u32 after the name for version 3, offset difference for older versions. No side effects.
Returns a pointer to the named member's data (0 if absent or not an EHP) and optionally its size. No side effects.
Binds an archive once: writes "BIND" over "NOT ", prepares members, then runs and clears the one-shot callback at 0x08921918. Returns 0 if flag is negative, else 1.

Prepares each member in place by extension (ptrs.txt resource lists turned into pointers, .tmt/.tma/.tms/.ehf/.gim handlers, runtime handler table). Returns 1. Side effects: member data, handler state.
If cardinfo is loaded: clears 0x1e2c bytes at 0x08924d1c, binds the archive and stores pointers to its 14 members in the globals there. Returns the loaded flag.
Record index of a card id via CARD_IntID; 0 for ids below 0xe88. No side effects.
Pointer to the card's UTF-16 name in CARD_Name. No side effects.
Pointer to the card's 8-byte CARD_Prop record. No side effects.
The card's passcode from CARD_Pass. No side effects.
Decodes and expands the card's description into the next of four rotating 0x77a-byte buffers at 0x08924d5c and returns it. Side effects: rotation counter 0x08926b44, that buffer.
Huffman-decodes one description with the CARD_Huff tree into out until the zero symbol; returns out. Side effects: out only.
Copies in to out, replacing $d + three characters with dictionary words; returns out. Side effects: out only.
Returns dictionary word number; when it contains %c + four digits, expands card names into the next of 50 rotating 0x200-byte buffers at 0x08ac6580. 0 when out of range.
Status from the built-in limit list (0 forbidden, 1 limited, 2 semi-limited) or 3 when unlisted. No side effects.
Sets every card id 0xe88-0x1f39 to unlimited, then applies the 114 built-in limit entries, via deck_set_limit.
C strcpy. Side effects: dst.
C strcat. Side effects: dst.
C strlen. No side effects.
C strcasecmp using the ctype table at 0x088779c9. No side effects.

column2: void * system_bsearch(void *key, void *base, uint count, uint size, void *compare)
column3: C bsearch; returns the matching element or 0. No side effects.
1 when buf starts with the gzip magic 1F 8B. No side effects.

column2: int sceGzipDecompress(void *dst, uint dst_size, void *src, uint *crc32)
column3: Inflates a gzip stream into dst; returns the output size or an SCE error code and stores the trailer CRC-32. Side effects: dst, crc32.

Builds "cardinfo_" + language code + ".ehp" and queues its load from root 5 (duelsys) into 0x08926b50 with completion callback card_db_on_cardinfo_loaded. Side effects: clears the loaded flag 0x08926b48, sets 0x08926b4c.
File-thread completion callback of card_db_load_cardinfo: sets the loaded flag 0x08926b48 to 1 and returns 1 (accept the read).
Appends the upper-cased first letter of the current language code (table 0x08878c88) and the suffix string at 0x0889f8b0 to name. Side effects: name only.
Returns 0xffff when bit 0 of CARD_Prop word 1 (the odd card kind) is set, which holds for every real record, else 0 (record 0, unused ids). No side effects.
The card's position in the alphabetical list, CARD_Sort[index]. No side effects.
CARD_Prop word 1 bits 22-24 (meaning unknown; values 0, 1, 3, 4). Exported. No side effects.
Linear search of ids 0xe88-0x1f39 for the passcode; returns the card id or -1 (also for passcode 0). No side effects.
Pointer to UTF-16 DLG string number: DLG_Text + DLG_Indx[number]. No bounds check. No side effects.
Name of a monster type (race): DLG 500 + race, or the empty fallback string 0x088a711c for 0. No side effects.
Kind suffix ("/Effect", "/Fusion", ...): DLG 550 + kind after mapping tuner kinds 15/16 to 11, synchro 17 to 12, 18 to 13 and other kinds above 10 to 1; fallback string for kind 0. No side effects.
Attribute name: DLG 530 + attribute (1 LIGHT ... 9 TRAP), fallback string for 0. No side effects.
Spell/trap icon name: DLG 570 + icon (1 Counter ... 7 Normal), fallback string for 0. No side effects.
Monster type (race), CARD_Prop word 1 bits 17-21 (23 spell, 24 trap). No side effects.
Attribute, CARD_Prop word 1 bits 6-9. No side effects.
Level, CARD_Prop word 1 bits 10-13. No side effects.
Spell/trap icon, CARD_Prop word 1 bits 14-16. No side effects.
Card kind index, CARD_Prop word 1 bits 1-5 (stored kind >> 1: 0 normal, 1 effect, ... 10 token, 13 spell, 14 trap); ids 0x1386-0x1388 always return 11. No side effects.
ATK = 10 x CARD_Prop word 0 bits 14-22; the value 0x1ff ("?") returns 0. No side effects.
DEF = 10 x CARD_Prop word 0 bits 23-31; 0x1ff ("?") returns 0. No side effects.
Like card_db_get_atk but returns 0xffff for "?". No side effects.
Like card_db_get_def but returns -1 for "?". No side effects.
Non-zero when CARD_Genre bit genre is set: word genre >> 4, bit genre & 15 of the record's three u16. No side effects.
Genre name, DLG 701 + genre for 0 <= genre < 40, else the fallback string 0x088a711c. No side effects.
Copies the record's three CARD_Genre words to out[0..2]. Side effects: out.
card_db_has_genre(card_id, table[filter]) with the 35-entry u32 table at 0x0889f980. No side effects.
Number of CARD_Top entries (27). No side effects.
Character of CARD_Top entry n (0 when n > count). No side effects.
First card id of CARD_Top entry n (0 when n > count). No side effects.
Index of the CARD_Top letter group that contains the card: last n whose first card sorts at or before it. No side effects.
Number of artworks: binary search of CARD_SamePict by record index, n + 1 when listed, 1 otherwise, 0 if the table is missing. No side effects.
Copies in to out, replacing "$m" + four digits with the name of that card id (format 0x0889f978); other "$x" pairs are copied unchanged. Returns out. Side effects: out.
1 when card_db_get_kind is 10 (token). No side effects.
1 when the card's race is 24 (trap). No side effects.
1 when the .cip header held at reader+0xac has magic "CPJ\x1a". No side effects.
1 when the .cip header held at reader+0xac has magic "CPM\x1a". No side effects.

Finds the next pending slot (state 1) in the reader's slot table, picks a buffer, marks the slot 2 and queues container_read_async of its sectors with callback card_db_on_cip_slot_read. Returns 1 if a read was queued.

Read-completion callback: unmasks the buffer for CPJ files (XOR head, then LCG stream), stores the buffer pointer in the slot and queues the next slot; clears reader flag bit 1 when none is left. Returns 1.
Pointer to the reader's slot table, reader + 0xac + *(reader+0xc8): pairs (sector, state or buffer) ending in -1. No side effects.
Returns the next of the reader's rotating image buffers (base +0x94, count +0x98, index +0x9c, size spi x 0x800) and resets slots whose data lived in it. Side effects: index, slot table.
Writes status (0-3) into bits 0-1 of byte 2 of the card's save collection record; ignored for status >= 4 or cards without a record. Side effects: game state.
The save's limit status of the card (byte 2 bits 0-1 of its collection record); 3 (unlimited) when it has no record. No side effects.
Limit status for deck building: the built-in list (deck_get_default_limit) when the flag 0x08aa5688 is set or use_builtin is 1, else the save copy (deck_get_limit). No side effects.
deck_get_card_limit(0, card_id). Exported. No side effects.
Clears the 0x80-byte UTF-16 field at game state +0x16582 and copies up to 63 units of name into it. Called by deck_reset_limits. Side effects: game state.
Pointer to the limit-list name at game state +0x16582. No side effects.
Pointer to the 0xc0-byte card lists (counts, main, side, extra) of deck slot slot: game state + 0x4914 + 0x16c x slot. No side effects.
Copies the 0xc0-byte card lists of deck slot slot to out. Side effects: out.
Copies the 64-byte UTF-16 deck name of slot slot (game state + 0x48d4 + 0x16c x slot) to out and forces a terminating NUL. Side effects: out.
Copies 64 bytes of name into the deck name of slot slot and forces a terminating NUL. Side effects: game state.

Fills the 0xc0-byte deck struct from member RCP<recipe>.ydc of the embedded archive 0x088d77e0 (main, extra, side with limits 60/15/15); clears it if the member is missing or a count is too large. Side effects: deck.
UTF-16 name of a recipe from recipe_name_<l>.bin (letter from "jegfis" by language), or 0 when RCP<recipe>.ydc does not exist. Result in the dictionary word buffers.
Level of a recipe from the u16 table at 0x089143f0 for 0 <= recipe < 462, else 1. No side effects.
Number of recipes of an owner (bsearch of the 126 x 16-byte table at 0x08915f28, field +8), 0 if unknown. No side effects.
Recipe number first + n of an owner when 0 <= n < count, else -1. No side effects.

Variant index of an owner's deck for a stage from the 67 x 12-byte table at 0x08916730 (owner 8 stage 1 adds 1 when the character has 2000 points or more); -1, 0 or 1 for other character modes. No side effects.
deck_get_owner_recipe(owner, deck_select_owner_variant(owner, stage)). No side effects.
bsearch comparator of the owner table: *a - *b. No side effects.
Base of the in-memory game state that DATA0 mirrors: 0x08aa5794 + 4 x (u32 at 0x08ac18c0, a random 0-15 chosen at boot). No side effects.

Clears 0x1c0ec bytes of game state and builds a new game: language kept, system nickname (at most 8 units, "$" doubled) at +0xfd5c, starting deck from recipe 0 (cards added to the collection, name in slot 1), OpenPSID at +0x10, default options, default limits, version 0x30000 at +0.

Writes the default option bits of the settings block and default volumes (0x08841724) and a 12-word block from 0x0885c084. Callers system_init_game_globals, save_init_new_game. Side effects: game state.
Pointer to the card's 4-byte collection record at game state + 0x11ba4 + 4 x index; 0 for index 0 and for tokens. No side effects.
Copies owned: collection byte 1 bits 0-6 (0 without a record). No side effects.
Sets the copies owned (bits 0-6 of byte 1) and the state bits 1-2 of byte 0: 2 if the card already had copies, else 1 (count > 0) or 0. Side effects: game state.
add != 0: one more copy (max 99), state 0 becomes 1 (new); add == 0: one copy fewer (not below 0). Side effects: game state.
Sets the state bits 1-2 of collection byte 0 to 2 (owned, no longer new). Side effects: game state.
1 when the collection state (byte 0 bits 1-2) is 1. No side effects.
Collection state, byte 0 bits 1-2: 0 never obtained, 1 new, 2 owned. No side effects.
Bit 3 of collection byte 0 (0 without a record). No side effects.
Sets bit 3 of collection byte 0. Side effects: game state.
Pointer to the 0x2a-byte record of pack pack at game state + 0x16604 + 0x2a x pack, 0 for pack >= 48. No side effects.
Writes state into bits 0-2 of pack record byte 1 (keeping bit 2 if it was set). Side effects: game state.
Pack record byte 1 bits 0-2 (0 for an invalid pack). No side effects.
Pointer to the 20 u16 entries at pack record +2 (0 for an invalid pack). No side effects.

column2: void save_set_pack_entry(int pack, int n, ushort value)
column3: Stores value in entry n (< 20) of a pack record. Side effects: game state.
Entry n (< 20) of a pack record, 0 when out of range. No side effects.
For all 48 packs: byte 0 = 0xaa, entries cleared (0x28 bytes). Side effects: game state.
Pointer to the settings bytes at game state + 0xfe04. No side effects.
Language index, settings byte 0 bits 0-2 (0 J, 1 E, 2 G, 3 F, 4 I, 5 S, after the "jegfis" letters). No side effects.
Writes settings byte 0 bits 0-2, then calls 0x088373c8. Side effects: game state.
Sets or clears one of six option bits: options 0-2 settings byte 1 bits 5-7, options 3-5 byte 2 bits 0, 3, 4. Side effects: game state.
Reads the option bit written by save_set_option_flag; 0 for other options. No side effects.
u32 n at game state + 0xfdfc + 4n (meaning not established). No side effects.
Pointer to the 0x18-byte per-character records at game state + 0xfe0c. No side effects.
Pointer to the character's 0x18-byte record. No side effects.
Appends value to the character record's u16 list (count at +0, up to 10 entries at +2) unless already present. Side effects: game state.
The character's points, u16 at record +0x16. No side effects.
Sets the points clamped to 0-8000. Side effects: game state.
Adds delta to the points, clamped to 0-8000. Side effects: game state.
Character 2-142 with the most points (first one on ties). No side effects.

Starts a save-data session: allocates from heap a 0x200 work block, a buffer for msd_e.ehp, the 0x9d0-byte SceUtilitySavedataParam and the 0x20000 save buffer, and queues msd_e.ehp from root 6. Returns 0 (and frees) on failure, else 1.
Frees the four save-session blocks to their heap and clears the pointers 0x08acda04-0x08acda10.
Completion callback of save_open: sets 0x08acd9f0 and binds the loaded msd_e.ehp archive. Returns 1.
Returns the file name "msd_e.ehp" (0x088a15cc). No side effects.

column2: int container_load_file(int root, char *path, void *dest, int size, void *callback, void *arg)
column3: Queues a whole-file read: container_read_async(root, path, dest, 0, size, callback, arg). Returns 1.

column2: int container_read_async(int root, char *path, void *dest, int offset, int size, void *callback, void *arg)
column3: Claims the next of 32 0x60-byte request slots at 0x08920cb4 under semaphore 0x089218b8, fills it as type 0 (read) and signals the queue semaphore 0x089218bc. Returns 1.
sceGzipDecompress with the CRC discarded; returns the output size or an SCE error. Exported. Side effects: dst.
If the one-shot callback slot 0x08921918 is free, stores callback and runs container_ehp_bind(ehp, 1); returns 1 then, else 0 without binding.

Clears the 0xc1c-byte file-queue state at 0x08920cac, stores config[0] as the root path table, starts the file thread (priority 0x6f, 8 KiB stack) and creates "ehfile_sema" and "ehfile_queue". Returns 1.

File thread: waits on the queue semaphore, takes a request, runs it (type 0 container_read_file, type 1 system_load_module), passes the result to callback(arg, result) and repeats the operation until the callback returns non-zero; then frees the slot.
First busy request slot, scanning the 32-slot ring from the write index 0x089218b4; 0 if none. No side effects.

column2: int container_read_file(int root, char *path, void *dest, int offset, int size)
column3: Synchronous read of size bytes at offset: resolves the path; non-disc paths via sceIoOpen/Lseek/Read/Close, disc paths via container_read_disc_file. Returns bytes read, -1 if the open fails, -2 if the seek fails.

column2: int container_read_disc_file(char *path, void *dest, int offset, int size)
column3: Same as container_read_file for a resolved disc path, through the wrappers 0x0881e2c4 (open), 0x0881e448 (seek), 0x0881e378 (read). Returns bytes read, -1 or -2.
Clears the scene slot 0x08920be4, requests module name (or the static function when name is 0), creates and starts thread "ehscript" at the caller's priority + 1 and runs it once. Returns 1.
Scene thread state machine on 0x08920c3c (1 load, 2 start, 3 enter, 5 run/exit); wakes the main thread after every step.
Load callback of the scene thread: stores uid at slot+0x50 when positive; returns uid > 0.
Resumes the scene thread and sleeps until it wakes the caller, then suspends it again. Returns 1.
Stores the scene's start and end callbacks and argument at 0x08920c28/2c/30. Returns 1.
Copies basename plus the suffix at 0x0889ed84 into the requested-name buffer 0x08920be8. Returns 1.
Requests the "staticmodule" pseudo-scene with fn as its function; fn is dropped (0) when its first word is a MIPS j instruction. Returns 1.
Resolves root + path and calls sceKernelLoadModule(path, 0, 0); returns the module UID or an error.

column2: int system_queue_module_load(int root, char *path, void *callback, void *arg)
column3: Queues a type-1 request (module load) in the file-thread queue. Returns 1.
Clears the 0x1304-byte registry at 0x089235b4, replaces roots -1/-2 of the built-in table 0x0889f57c by root_a/root_b and registers it.
Adds each 16-byte descriptor (id, root, name, kind) not yet registered as a 76-byte entry, then sorts the registry by id. Returns 1 if an id was already present.
bsearch of the registry by id; entry or 0. No side effects.
system_module_load_ex(id, 0, 0, 0x089248b8, 0). Returns 1 for an unknown id, else 0.

column2: int system_module_load_ex(int id, int argsize, void *argp, int *status, void *option)
column3: Increments the reference count and, when not loaded, queues the load (kind 0) with start arguments or loads a utility module (kind 4). Returns 1 for an unknown id, else 0.
Load callback: stores uid, sceKernelStartModule with the saved arguments, state 2. Returns uid > 0.
0 while any registry entry is in state 1 (loading), else 1. No side effects.
Decrements the reference count of a loaded module and stops/unloads it at 0. Returns 1 for an unknown id or a module still loading, else 0.
Module file name without its 4-character extension, copied to 0x089248c0; 0 for an unknown id.
Module file name copied to 0x089248e0; 0 for an unknown id.
system_module_load of ids 2-5 (video playback). Returns 0.
system_module_unload of ids 5-2. Returns 0.

Loads module ids 3, 7, 6 and waits for them, creates the 0x280000-byte heap at 0x08acda40, installs three callbacks (0x088414a0, 0x08841514, 0x08841554) through 0x08869290 and calls 0x08841724(n, 12) for n = 0-2.
Loads and starts libfont.prx, opens the default font (and an optimum 20 x 20 font when alt_font), stores its metrics and sets the alternative character 0x25a1. Returns 1.
Module base name of a scene id through the 31-entry table 0x088a1478 (sorted on first use); "unknown id" otherwise.

column2: void system_scene_call(int from, int to, int arg)
column3: Pushes transition {1, from, to, arg} on the scene stack and requests to's module.
Sets the current transition to {2, from, caller, arg}, pops the stack and requests the caller's module.

column2: void system_scene_jump(int from, int to, int arg)
column3: Clears the scene stack, sets {3, from, to, arg} and requests to's module.
from of the top stack entry when its to is scene, else 31. No side effects.
Copies the current 8-byte transition to out. Side effects: out.
Returns the 144-byte scene stack at 0x08aa56a4. No side effects.
Comparator of the scene table: *b - *a. No side effects.
Comparator of the module registry: *b - *a. No side effects.

Boot sequence and main loop: callbacks, UMD activation, file index, file thread, module registries, audio, game globals, font, scene "rel_title"; then per frame rand step, scene slice and housekeeping. Never returns.

column2: int system_exit_callback(int arg1, int arg2, void *common)
column3: Exit callback ("EXIT_CALLBACK"): calls 0x0882b8c0, then sceKernelExitGame. Returns 0.

column2: int system_power_callback(int unknown, int power_flags, void *common)
column3: Power callback ("POWER_CALLBACK"): stores power_flags at 0x08ac24bc. Returns 0.
When the pad state from 0x088284b8 (+0x24) holds SELECT+START+L+R (0x309) and 0x0881dd48 and 0x08835aac both return 0, reboots with sceKernelLoadExec("disc0:/PSP_GAME/SYSDIR/BOOT.BIN").

Binds the six embedded EHP archives, clears 0x1cefc bytes at 0x08aa5680, creates a 16 KiB heap, seeds rand, picks the random game-state offset 0x08ac18c0, finds loading.ehf and writes default options.
system_rand() >> 4. No side effects beyond the generator.
newlib reentrancy struct: the one at *(k0+4) when the thread has one, else the global at 0x0889e5b0. No side effects.
C strncpy (pads with NUL up to n). Returns dst. Side effects: dst.
strncpy for UTF-16: copies up to n units and pads with 0. Returns dst. Side effects: dst.
C sprintf through system_vfprintf_r with a string FILE of unlimited size; NUL-terminates buf.

column2: void system_qsort(void *base, uint count, uint size, void *compare)
column3: C qsort (BSD-style median-of-three quicksort with insertion sort below 7 elements). Side effects: base.
C malloc: system_malloc_r(system_get_reent(), size).
C free: system_free_r(system_get_reent(), ptr).
Initialises a "HOGE" (0x45474f48) heap header with its block list inside memory (when memory is 0, allocates a 16-byte header through 0x0880d1a0 instead). Returns the heap or 0.
Allocates size bytes rounded up to 16 from a HOGE heap (tail call to 0x08826458 with flag 1); 0 on failure or size < 1.
Marks the block of ptr free (header bit 31), bumps the heap's free counter and relinks the block through 0x08826fb8 (twice) and 0x088270ac. Returns 1.
bsearch of the 174 x 148-byte character records at 0x088aa510 by (u8 character, s8 variant); record or 0. No side effects.
Comparator of the character records: by u8 character, then signed u8 variant. No side effects.
1 when world_find_character finds a record. No side effects.
First bank of the character's voice set (record +0x30); 0 for characters 0 and 1. No side effects.
First of the four small voice banks (record +0x34) when the record has a voice set, else 0; 0 for characters 0 and 1. No side effects.
Global sound id of the bank's first cue: first[bank] through *(*0x08dd3004 + 0x20). No side effects.
Once per TMT ("TGMT", flag bit 0 at +0x34): turns the six section offsets into pointers and the per-entry data offsets into addresses. Returns tmt, or 0 when it is not a TGMT.
Once per TMA ("TGMA", flag at +0x20): turns three section offsets and the entry data offsets into pointers. Returns tma, or 0 when the magic differs.

Once per TMS ("TGMS", flag at +0x5c): relocates its sections, links each object's four sub-entries to their 0x28-byte records, replaces sub-entry type codes 2/1 by the functions 0x0882f050/0x0882ef50 and passes each record name through the hook 0x08924b14. Returns tms or 0.
Clears words +8 and +0xc of a GIM member at bind time. Side effects: gim.
Sets ctx+0x14 to a TGMT: used in place, or gunzipped into one of two alternating buffers and bound; 0 for null data.
For each 16-byte record of the EHF table (+0x30 offset, +0x34 size): callback(arg, record) and record+0xc = next tmf byte (0 without tmf). Returns 1.

Adds delta to the DP word at save state +0xfdfc, clamped to 0..999999999; a positive delta is also added to +0xfe00 (cumulative DP earned, hypothesis), capped at 999999999. Only a0 is read. Callers: the thunk_save_add_dp import stubs of the game modules (rel_story, rel_shop, rel_field, rel_duel_mgr and others).

newlib rand(): the 64-bit state in the reentrancy block (+0xa8/+0xac) becomes state * 0x5851F42D4C957F2D + 1; returns bits 32-62. Side effects: RNG state. Callers: system_rand_shifted, 0x0884adf0, 0x0884ae5c.
newlib srand(): RNG state = seed (high word 0). Side effects: RNG state. Callers: system_seed_rand_from_rtc, 0x088596cc, 0x0881d028.
system_srand(low word of sceRtcGetCurrentTick). Side effects: RNG state. Caller: system_init_game_globals.
Game state byte +0x1542a + pack = 1 (the pack was bought at least once). Side effects: game state. Callers: the rel_shop purchase steps (shop_buy_single_step, shop_buy_shelf_step, shop_buy_box_step).
Adds count to the u16 at game state +0x16602 (packs bought in total), capped at 2000. Side effects: game state. Callers: the rel_shop purchase steps.
Pack record byte 0 = stock (two nibbles: packs left in the two shelf columns). Side effects: game state. Callers: save_reset_packs, shop_save_pack_stock (rel_shop).
Pack record byte 0, the shelf stock (0 for an invalid pack). No side effects. Caller: shop_load_pack_states (rel_shop).
